items.title: Build the review evidence pack for the execution plan document
items.context: Collect the target document state, current diff, and code-backed truth sources needed for review: prompt registry, agent_prompt, reviewer lanes, review_run_start/finding/pass, init-check gate, evaluator save/eval-evidence, milestone_status UX, process-fact registry, command policy, and existing CLI docs. The evidence pack must explicitly prefer current code facts over stale plan prose.
items.userSees: User sees "Evidence pack complete for B-2861: document state, diff, and code-backed review references are listed."

happy.desc: Evidence pack cites the target document, current diff/status, and current code/CLI truth sources needed to review gates, reviewer lanes, evaluator evidence, milestone_status UX, and prompt registry behavior.

edge.desc: Evidence pack distinguishes current code facts from stale planning prose and records when a referenced behavior is only planned.

adversarial.desc: Evidence pack does not treat prompt text, raw evaluator JSON, or host review prose as gate evidence.

verificationEvidence.note: Evidence pack is present in the document heading map and includes the B-2861 3x2 review ledger, gate/UX sections, execution matrix, artifact schema, story breakdown, and completion definition.
Evidence pack distinguishes current code facts from planning prose, including reviewer lane prefixes, INIT required agents, milestone UX behavior, DONE-required policy, and unsigned openQuestions.
Scope contract now reports only acknowledged warnings for required ProofStory metadata; the target document is within the document-review scope and no runtime/code files were changed.

items.title: Run the 3x2 independent review over the document
items.context: Use Codex CLI, Claude Code CLI, and Antigravity CLI as the three host labels. Each host should inspect the document from two lenses: lifecycle/gate correctness and prompt/routing/UX practicality. Reviewers must cite concrete project evidence and identify blockers, risks, and suggested optimizations without treating prompt text as gate evidence.
items.userSees: User sees "3x2 review complete for B-2861: six host/lens findings are recorded or explicitly classified."

happy.desc: Review records cover three host labels and two lenses per host: lifecycle/gate correctness and prompt/routing/UX practicality.

edge.desc: Review wording scopes Antigravity CLI to this explicit 3x2 review and does not rewrite global default host policy.

adversarial.desc: Review findings cite project evidence rather than accepting advice or prompt prose without verification.

verificationEvidence.command: codex exec, claude --print, and agy --print review runs
verificationEvidence.note: Three hosts completed: Codex CLI from a prepared evidence pack, Claude Code CLI read-only against the worktree, and Antigravity CLI read-only against the worktree.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "B-2861 3x2 Review Follow-Up Ledger|Codex CLI|Claude Code CLI|Antigravity" docs/requirements/decisions/proof-or-stop-agent-prompt-consolidation-execution-plan.md
verificationEvidence.note: The document records all three host labels and their two-lens review framing, including the limitation on the interrupted Codex run and evidence-pack rerun.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "Rejected for this story|design input, not gate evidence|document-only" docs/requirements/decisions/proof-or-stop-agent-prompt-consolidation-execution-plan.md
verificationEvidence.note: The 3x2 output is not blindly accepted as gate evidence; runtime-code suggestions are explicitly rejected for this document-only story and reclassified as future implementation constraints.

items.title: Reconcile 3x2 findings into an actionable optimization ledger
items.context: Deduplicate overlapping findings, classify each as accept/reject/defer, identify owner milestone/story impact, and record evidence references. The ledger must explain when a suggestion is rejected or deferred because current code evidence contradicts it.
items.userSees: User sees "Optimization ledger complete for B-2861: findings are classified accept/reject/defer with evidence."

happy.desc: Reconciliation ledger deduplicates host/lens findings and classifies each actionable item as accept, reject, or defer.

edge.desc: Deferred and rejected suggestions include explicit code or policy evidence explaining why they are not applied now.

adversarial.desc: Ledger does not hide disagreement between hosts or collapse conflicting findings into vague consensus.

verificationEvidence.note: Optimization ledger classifies accepted and rejected findings with source host/lens, applied document change, reason, and evidence.

Ledger preserves nuanced items rather than hiding disagreement: openQuestions are warning/deferred-code, reviewer UX is accepted with scope boundary, channel is read-compatible legacy, and M0.5 is split.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "Immediately update runtime code|Rejected for this story|not gate evidence" docs/requirements/decisions/proof-or-stop-agent-prompt-consolidation-execution-plan.md
verificationEvidence.note: The ledger explicitly rejects scope creep into runtime code and states 3x2 outputs are design input, not gate evidence.

items.title: Apply approved documentation optimizations without weakening gates
items.context: Update the execution plan only where evidence supports the change. Preserve hard lifecycle gates, reviewer-run binding, evaluator raw-vs-saved evidence boundary, milestone_status UX contract, legacy read compatibility, canonical proof-or-stop-* writes, and no direct story-file artifact mutation by prompts.
items.userSees: User sees "Approved optimizations applied to the Proof-or-Stop execution plan without code-scope expansion."

happy.desc: Accepted 3x2 findings are applied to the target document and each edit preserves hard gates, structured evidence boundaries, legacy compatibility, and milestone_status UX rules.

edge.desc: If a finding implies a future code change, the document records it as a future implementation story rather than changing code in B-2861.

adversarial.desc: Document edits do not introduce new prompt-only gate evidence, direct story-file writes, or silent reviewer overlap.

verificationEvidence.note: Committed document optimizations in fac8f979a, adding the execution plan and scope acknowledgement without runtime code changes.
Approved optimizations are applied: reviewer UX boundary, DONE-required evidence, openQuestions warning, INIT required-agent normalization, and reviewer predicate risk are documented.
Whitespace check passes and scope contract has no blocking violations after acknowledgement; code/CLI docs remain read-only evidence sources.

items.title: Produce DONE optimization table with reasons and evidence
items.context: Before marking DONE, add or provide a complete table listing each concrete optimization made, why it was made, what project evidence supports it, which 3x2 finding or host/lens motivated it, and whether it changed milestone order, agent responsibility, input/output contract, UX contract, or validation coverage.
items.userSees: User sees "DONE optimization table ready: every applied document optimization has reason, evidence, 3x2 source, and affected contract area."

happy.desc: Final optimization table lists every concrete optimization made, its reason, supporting project evidence, motivating 3x2 finding or host/lens, and affected area.

edge.desc: Table distinguishes concrete applied optimizations from deferred or rejected suggestions and does not imply unimplemented code behavior has shipped.

adversarial.desc: DONE response and document table cannot claim completion unless the target document contains or is accompanied by the required evidence-backed optimization table.

verificationEvidence.note: The DONE optimization table is the B-2861 3x2 Review Follow-Up Ledger and includes reason/evidence columns plus completion-definition linkage.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "Accepted with scope boundary|Accepted as warning|Rejected for this story" docs/requirements/decisions/proof-or-stop-agent-prompt-consolidation-execution-plan.md
verificationEvidence.note: The DONE table separates accepted, accepted-with-boundary, warning/deferred-code, and rejected items instead of claiming every suggestion was applied.
Final checks found no whitespace errors and verified the document still lists all 16 proof-or-stop agent migration sections.

auditLog.reason: Evidence pack, 3x2 review records, scope check, and committed document evidence are complete.
Recording the completed three-host two-lens review work.
Codex CLI, Claude Code CLI, and Antigravity CLI 3x2 review results are recorded in the B-2861 review ledger.
